plugin.name: Aardwolf_Auto_Open
plugin.author: FesterHead
plugin.purpose: Automatically opens closed doors when attempting to move
plugin.description: Automatically opens doors, gates, walls, and other barriers when you try to walk in a direction and they are closed.

muclient.script:
local last_direction = nil local is_auto_sending = false
local direction_map = { n = "north", north = "north", s = "south", south = "south", e = "east", east = "east", w = "west", west = "west", u = "up", up = "up", d = "down", down = "down", ne = "northeast", northeast = "northeast", nw = "northwest", northwest = "northwest", se = "southeast", southeast = "southeast", sw = "southwest", southwest = "southwest", }
function OnPluginSend (sText) if is_auto_sending then return true end
local cmd = sText:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"):lower() local direction = direction_map[cmd] if not direction then local dir_part = cmd:match("^go%s+(%a+)$") if dir_part then direction = direction_map[dir_part] end end
if direction then last_direction = direction end
return true end
function handle_closed_door (name, line, wildcards) if last_direction then local dir = last_direction last_direction = nil -- Prevent infinite loop if door is locked ColourNote("cyan", "", "[Auto-Open] Attempting to open " .. dir .. "...") is_auto_sending = true Send("open " .. dir) Send(dir) is_auto_sending = false end end
function handle_locked_or_no_key (name, line, wildcards) last_direction = nil ColourNote("orange", "", "[Auto-Open] Stopped: " .. line) DiscardQueue() end
function OnPluginInstall() Note("-> Auto Open Doors Plugin Loaded.") end
